_comment: Per-plugin adaptation configuration. Lives in the build repo root.
_instructions: Copy to your build repo root and customize. Dependency SOURCE PATHS come from the machine-local config (engines.local.json → dependencies), NOT here. This file lists which dependencies to embed and the cherry-pick ranges.

cherry_pick_ranges._comment_range: For each engine version (high→low), specify the git commit range to cherry-pick from the old adaptation branch.
cherry_pick_ranges._comment_format: Range format: '<start_commit>..<end_commit>' where start is the upstream sync point and end is the next version boundary.
cherry_pick_ranges._comment_example_5.8: 5.8 range is: upstream-sync..set-5.7 (base adaptations common to all)

dependencies.name: <DepA>
dependencies._comment: Name must match a key in engines.local.json → dependencies. Its source path is looked up there.
